name: Myanmar
value: Junta claims resistance HQ near Mon–Bago line
summary: Junta says it took a resistance command and 10 bases on the Mon–Bago border; no major city has changed hands
state: State media said on 10 Nov that the army seized a NUG special region command and 10 other bases along the Mon state–Bago region border after a six-day operation; the claim could not be independently verified (AP via Khaosod English; The Star, 11 Nov). Searches on 14 Nov found no major city changing hands, no new confirmed mass-casualty airstrike and no cross-border escalation, so the signal stays at Watch.
for_you: Civilians in contested areas face airstrikes and displacement. FCDO advises against travel to much of Myanmar. Neighbouring Thailand, India, Bangladesh and China are most exposed to refugee flows and border disruption.
rubric_hit: Civil war at sustained intensity (Watch); no major city fall or confirmed mass-casualty airstrike

sources.title: Khaosod English (AP) — Myanmar army seizes key resistance headquarters and 10 bases held by opposition, state media says
The Star — Military seizes key resistance headquarters in six-day blitz

why: A multi-sided civil war affecting 50 million people, with spillover to China, Thailand, India and Bangladesh.
drivers: Resistance offensives, junta airstrikes, Chinese mediation, elections, humanitarian access.

rubric.alert: Major city falls, mass-casualty airstrikes, or cross-border escalation.
